description: Frozen CE-replication levels underlying the committed 2025 nowcast.

provenance.source: Historical output committed before the 2025 BLS publication
provenance.calculation: scripts/compute_nowcast_2025.py using BLS CE windows, mortgage principal included, quarter-times-four annualization, and the 82 percent anchor
provenance.reason_frozen: The 2025 nowcast is an immutable forecasting commitment. Later corrections to the general CE replication code must not rewrite the estimate being evaluated.
provenance.known_legacy_behavior: These levels predate the CUTENURE six-code correction and strict family-composition validation. They are retained only to reproduce the historical nowcast, not as current CE-method estimates.
